about: L7 T6d golden set, written before any v2 run; v1 (evals/golden-v1.json) stays frozen as it was. Same 14 questions and split as v1, each now also listing values its answer must not hold, so an answer that returns everything can fail. Expected and absent values are written from the synthetic fixtures (src/data/finance.ts, models, datasets), never copied from the code under test. Tuning may read improvement results only; holdout metrics are printed only on request.
split: As v1: stratified by domain; improvement holds the copilot's own suggestions and their siblings, holdout holds paraphrases and questions not yet asked of the system.
changes_from_v1: absent: values a correct answer must not contain; exactness is the share of answers holding none of them
every tool result is read, not only the first; the expected tool must have returned a result
citations are read from what the finance tool returned, not by answering the question again
the draft the model wrote is kept beside the answer, with whether the draft check withheld it, for the judge (T5b)
holdout metrics are printed only when asked (GOLDEN_HOLDOUT=1), never by the gate

metrics.tool_accuracy: Share of answers holding a result from the expected tool.
metrics.calculation_accuracy: Share of expected values found verbatim in the tool results.
metrics.exactness: Share of answers whose tool results hold none of the absent values.
metrics.unsupported_verified_claims: Count of answers where any tool result is VERIFIED while the expected state is not VERIFIED or an expected value is missing, plus drafts shown to the analyst that the draft check would withhold. The pass rule needs 0 in the holdout.
metrics.citation_precision: Over the citations the finance tool returned: those whose source gives the claim's own value, over all of them.
metrics.drafts: Drafts the model wrote, and how many the draft check withheld; the drafts themselves are kept for the judge.
metrics.latency_ms: Wall time of one ask, median.
metrics.cost_usd: Sum of each call's cost at the dated prices in src/lib/model.ts; 0 when no model is called.
metrics.n_and_se: n counts answers, q counts questions. Each standard error uses the q questions that contribute to its metric, sqrt(p(1-p)/q).

pass: The holdout shows 0 unsupported verified claims; the script exits non-zero otherwise. For the loop's deciding rule the holdout is run at least 3 times through the live model and its kept drafts are judged by a model other than the maker's (T5b).
